prerequisites.rationale_text: Knowing where your competence boundary lies is an inherently metacognitive act. The CoC article explicitly names metacognition as the skill that enables an expert to frame problems and assess whether proposed answers fall within or outside their circle.
prerequisites.source_quote: The CoC is a form of self-knowledge... It relies heavily on metacognition (thinking about thinking), enabling an expert to frame a problem and reflect on whether their proposed answer seems reasonable.

curation_notes.summary: Explicit dependency. Without metacognitive self-assessment, the practitioner cannot know where the perimeter of their competence is — the central challenge the CoC model addresses.
